ecg_psd, ) ``` ```{python} #| cell_id: a0d472f8f0ae41d0af191670b9ea521e #| deepnote_cell_type: code #| deepnote_to_be_reexecuted: false #| execution_millis: 404 #| execution_start: 1707236264765 #| label="Señal Original") plt.plot(time, ecg_filt, label="Señal Filtrada") plt.legend() ``` ```{python} #| cell_id: 7d344d0d23d143bfb7d363104c2839da #| deepnote_cell_type: code #| nonlinearfunction(x, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6): return p1+ p2*x + p3*np.sin(p4*x) + p5*np.cos(p6*x) popt, pcov = curve_fit(nonlinearfunction, time, ecg_01) plt.scatter(time, ecg_filt, label='Datos Originales') plt.plot(time, nonlinearfunction(time, *popt), color='red', label='Estimación No Lineal') plt.legend() plt.show() ecg_filt_trend1 = ecg_filt-nonlinearfunction(time, *popt) fig0005 = plt.figure() plt.plot(time, ecg_filt) plt.plot(time, ecg_filt_trend1) ``` ```{python} #| cell_id: 931562553b764801aa08ba40a52a2f4b #| deepnote_cell_type: code #| deepnote_to_be_reexecuted: false #| execution_millis: 2399 #| execution_start: 1707236346173 #| source_hash: null # Estimación LOESS lowess = sm.nonparametric.lowess(ecg_filt, time, frac=1/12) # Graficar los datos originales y la estimación LOESS plt.scatter(time, ecg_filt, label='Datos Originales') plt.plot(lowess[:, 0], lowess[:, 1], color='red', label='Estimación LOESS') plt.legend() plt.show() ecg_filt_trend2 = ecg_filt-lowess[:, 1] fig0004 = plt.figure() plt.plot(time, ecg_filt, label="Señal Original") plt.plot(time, ecg_filt_trend2, 'g', label="Señal sin artefacto respiratorio") plt.legend() plt.grid() ``` ```{python} #| cell_id: 9b74d446d56f4329a62b7e9061573e32 #| deepnote_cell_type: code #| deepnote_to_be_reexecuted: false #| execution_millis: 5 #| execution_start: 1707236510365 #| source_hash: null fcut1 = 50 fcut2 = 1 wcut1 = fcut1/(fs/2) wcut2 = fcut2/(fs/2) b, a = signal.butter(6, [wcut2, wcut1], "bandpass") ecg_filt2 = signal.filtfilt(b,a, ecg_01) fig0005 = plt.figure() plt.plot(time, ecg_01, label="Señal Original") plt.plot(time, ecg_filt2, label="Señal Filtrada") plt.legend() ``` ```{python} fig006 = plt.figure() plt.plot(time, ecg_filt_trend1, label="Usando regresión no lineal") plt.plot(time, ecg_filt_trend2, label="Usando regresión por partes") plt.plot(time, ecg_filt2, label="Usando Filtro pasabanda") plt.legend() plt.grid() ``` Created in Deepnote
